title: Aperiodic articulation cell
description: The codomain term of articulating. An aperiodic-articulation-cell is the ordered pair of a carrier utterance and a pairing term. The carrier utterance fixes the token and claim schema coordinates. The pairing term is an ordered pair of articulation slots: the token-side slot is empty or singleton token, and the claim-side slot is empty or singleton claim. Absence is slot structure, not a third primitive. This cell's library refines this shape by fixing which slots are empty and which are singleton -- each refinement is one of the four phases.
